product: commentary — no product. A UGC creator's portfolio example of green screen ads made while the product ships.
body: A recent ad where the brand requested green screen ads while the physical product was still shipping — portfolio example with contact email. 14s video attached.
idea: Green screen lets creators produce ads before the product arrives.

what_to_steal: For LC launches: brief green screen ads the day the brief goes out — don't wait for samples to ship.

product: commentary — no product. A 30-format folder tree for Meta ads.
hook: "📁 30 scroll-stopping Meta ads formats worth stealing right now."
body: Six folders of formats: Hooks (clear action, question, did-you-know, myth vs fact, stats, competitor breakdown); Founder Content (intro, journey→result, wish-I-knew, walking/car monologue, whiteboard); Social Proof (storytelling testimonial, customer call, IG comment reply, DM-I-get-every-day, street interview); Educational (knowledge drop, ingredient breakdown, before/after, doctor authority, 30min vs 30sec); Entertainment (POV, duo conversation, AI podcast, challenge, faceless b-roll); Creative (green screen breakdown, pint… truncated).
idea: Organize creative testing as a folder tree — green screen and comment reply each get their own slot.
why_it_works: A taxonomy turns random testing into coverage — every folder gets fed.
what_to_steal: The folder-tree structure for LC's creative testing: green screen breakdown and comment reply as permanent folders.

product: commentary — no product. Fifteen formats for repackaging winning angles ($30k/day proof).
hook: "We've scaled accounts to $30k/day on 3-4 core angles."
body: The secret is format count, not angle count. Formats: founder ads (authentic, uncopyable, conviction), yapper ads (raw trust, beats UGC), AI animation (entertainment that sells), UGC (still king with visual proof), voiceless text-overlay, longform VSL… plus carousel, reply ad, text wall, review static, camouflage per gist (truncated).
idea: Scale by repackaging 3–4 proven angles into many formats — including reply ads.
sequencing: Longform VSL… (truncated; reply ad per gist).
why_it_works: Proven angles de-risked; format multiplication finds new audiences for the same message.
what_to_steal: LC's winning angles repackaged into reply-ad and green screen formats as standing cells.

product: commentary — no product. Comment-reply UGC hooks are in the "printing" list for 2026.
body: Dead in 2026: polished studio product videos, "hey guys" UGC intros, discount-led statics, founder story VSLs. Printing right now: ugly advertorial statics, long-form yapper ads, comment-reply UGC hooks, us-vs-them comparison statics. Caveat: the format is never the biggest lever — the angle underneath is.
idea: Comment-reply hooks are a printing format.
sequencing: Dead: polished studio product videos plus "hey guys" UGC intros.
Dead: discount-led statics plus founder story VSLs.
Printing: ugly advertorial statics plus long-form yapper ads.
Printing: comment-reply UGC hooks plus us-vs-them comparison statics.
Caveat: the angle underneath is the bigger lever.
why_it_works: Replying to a comment borrows the comment's authenticity — the ad inherits a real conversation.
what_to_steal: Comment-reply hooks as an LC cell — reply to real review comments on camera.

what_to_steal: The transcript's carousel insights for LC: tweet-thread screenshot carousels and testimonial carousels as bottom-funnel plays.

product: commentary — no product. AI UGC tier list; reply-to-comment overlay in B tier as a modifier.
hook: "ranking every AI UGC format in tiers..."
body: S tier: podcast ad, talking head, in-car, claymation. A tier: zach-d-films escalation, street interview, pixar style, multi-scene demo. B tier: reply-to-comment overlay ("works on any format but is more of a modifier than a format"), chalkboard explainer, skeleton story, split screen day… (truncated).
idea: Reply-to-comment is a modifier that upgrades any format, not a format itself.
sequencing: S tier: podcast ad — best format for anything needing explanation.
S tier: talking head, in-car, claymation.
A tier: zach-d-films, street interview, pixar, multi-scene demo.
B tier: reply-to-comment overlay (a modifier), chalkboard, skeleton story, split screen day… (truncated).
why_it_works: Modifiers stack — a comment overlay adds authenticity to whatever's underneath.
what_to_steal: Treat comment-reply as an LC modifier: add comment overlays to winning LC videos, not just standalone reply ads.

product: commentary — no product. Ecom tier list; green screen reactions over a proven winner in A tier.
hook: "Ranking every type of ecom ad creative format."
body: F tier: AI UGC, street interviews, creator clearly reading script. C tier: lifestyle b-roll with voiceover, meme ads, repurposed TikToks. B tier: founder ads, testimonial compilations, listicle statics. A tier: before & after statics, podcast-style ads, green screen reactions over a proven winner. idea: Green screen reactions layered over proven winners are A-tier.
sequencing: A tier (green screen reactions over proven winner).
why_it_works: The proven winner underneath de-risks; the reaction adds fresh authenticity on top.
what_to_steal: LC green screen reactions over proven winner videos — reaction plus winner stacked.

product: commentary — no product. Ten AI UGC styles with production specs.
hook: "10 winning AI UGC styles you can test on your brand right now."
body: Ten styles with specs: talking-head testimonial, product-in-hand, first-try reaction, fake podcast, street interview, comment reply (real comment or FAQ pinned on screen, creator answers with the product in use, TikTok-reply energy), unboxing… plus DITL/GRWM, before/after, whiteboard per gist (truncated).
